links.outcome: LLM willingness to make decisions based on potentially discriminatory sociodemographic criteria in simulated nephrology cases
links.effect: ChatGPT 3.5 answered all scenario questions and never refused; ChatGPT 4.0 declined in 13 (16.3%) scenarios in round one and 5 (6.3%) in round two.
links.quote: ChatGPT 3.5 provided a response to all scenario questions and did not refuse to make decisions under any circumstances.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT 3.5 and 4.0 handling DEI considerations across 80 simulated nephrology scenarios without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
